title: PerformPage and ShapePage — fast controls, macros, multiband panel
description:
Implement Perform and Shape editor pages with APVTS-bound controls (spec §21.4–21.6).

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §21.4 Views (Perform, Shape), §21.5 Performance Page Controls, §21.6 Expert Inspector
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §26 Parameter Ranges and §27.1 Stable Parameter IDs
- Source/ParameterIDs.h for exact param ID strings
- Source/GUI/ChugLookAndFeel.h from i.1
- How sibling plugins attach sliders (AudioProcessorValueTreeState::SliderAttachment / ComboBoxAttachment patterns)

Implement PerformPage.h/.cpp:
- juce::Component hosting fast controls: Threshold, Tightness macro, Sustain macro, Hiss macro, Depth (broadband floor), Attack Guard, mode selector, topology selector, key source, lookahead, Learn Noise and Align DI action buttons (buttons may fire std::function / listener hooks set by editor — do not implement Learn/Align DSP here).
- Macro knobs should be primary; optional collapsible Expert Inspector row can surface mapped underlying params beneath macros (no hidden parameters when expanded).
- Construct with APVTS reference; own attachments for every bound control.

Implement ShapePage.h/.cpp:
- juce::Component for spectral topology shaping: full / dual / tri / Hiss Curtain selectors and related crossover + per-band floor/threshold-offset/release-multiplier controls, hissCurtain min/max/depth.
- Multiband panel layout that remains readable at min editor width (~920).
- APVTS attachments only; no processBlock or CMake edits.

Layouts use ChugLookAndFeel when set by parent. Leave space/comments for PerformanceTimeline embedding by i.6 if timeline is not a child of this page (Perform may include a timeline mount Component placeholder or simply arrange control grid — editor owns final placement).

Do NOT implement Detect/Align/Diagnose pages, MainHeader, PluginEditor, or CMakeLists.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: PerformPage binds Threshold, Tightness, Sustain, Hiss, Depth, Attack Guard, mode, topology, key source, and lookahead controls to APVTS ParameterIDs
PerformPage exposes Learn Noise and Align DI action hooks/buttons without implementing DSP
ShapePage exposes topology/crossover/per-band and Hiss Curtain controls bound to APVTS ParameterIDs
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: change DSP algorithms or parameter ranges in processor code

allowed: group macro knobs with optional expert inspector expand row
use FlexBox or manual bounds for min-size-friendly layout
forbidden: own tabbed editor shell or CMakeLists
hard-code parameter IDs that disagree with ParameterIDs.h
implement noise learn or DI calibration algorithms on the page
